what: While scrolling down a long pinned stage, the clip shape (rounded-corner polygon) of the photo window morphs into another polygon and the photos inside crossfade — the whole stage scroll is treated as 0~1, bound to scroll for len(.33) starting at at(.15), changing with no curve. Moving the window size and position along with it makes a photo window that changes shape while crossing the screen

options.at: Point where change begins in stage progress (0~1), default .15
options.track: Stage selector that measures the scroll, default nearest section

note: Without MorphSVGPlugin, the shape switches all at once in the middle. Shapes may have different point counts

from.where: index.html about section #frame1·#frame2 (900vh stage) — original morphSVG ease none · progress .15 to .33, photo A→B crossfade over the same range, window size and position move together with power1.inOut
service.html About section (gray stage) — same values
